purpose: Display selectable read-only text with an explicit clipboard action.

component: Render the supplied string as a read-only native input, or a three-row textarea when multiline. Keep text keyboard-selectable; this is not editable form state.
Generate a control id for the visible label and associate the optional description through aria-describedby.

Pass the exact value to the real CopyButton and derive its accessible label from the field label. The child uses navigator.clipboard, shows temporary success only after resolution and reports clipboard failure through notification.
host: Own the displayed value and sensitive-data policy. Supply an informative label and optional explanation; clipboard availability still depends on browser permission and secure context.
